title: Bioinformatics based exploration of the anti-NAFLD mechanism of Wang's empirical formula via TLR4/NF-kappaB/COX2 pathway.
authors: Chen, Suhong; Zhou, Chuanjie; Huang, Jiahui; Qiao, Yunlong; Wang, Ning; Huang, Yuzhen; Li, Bo; Xu, Wanfeng; He, Xinglishang; Wang, Kungen; Zhi, Yihui; Lv, Guiyuan; Shen, Shuhua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方抗脂肪肝的网络药理学与分子对接，对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) has developed as a leading public wellness challenge as a result of changes in dietary patterns. Unfortunately, there is still a lack of effective pharmacotherapy methods for NAFLD. Wang's empirical formula (WSF) has demonstrated considerable clinical efficacy in treating metabolic disorders for years. Nevertheless, the protective effect of WSF against NAFLD and its underlying mechanism remains poorly understood. METHODS: The NAFLD model was established using a 17-week high-sucrose and high-fat (HSHF) diet with 32 ICR mice. In assessing the therapeutic efficacy of WSF on NAFLD, we detected changes in body weight, viscera weight, biomarkers of glycolipid metabolism in serum and liver, transaminase levels and histopathology of liver with H&E and Oil Red O staining after oral administration. The chemical components in WSF were extensively identified and gathered utilizing the HPLC-Q-TOF/MS system, database mining from HMDB, MassBank, and TCMSP databases, alongside literature searches from CNKI, Wanfang and VIP databases. The forecast of network pharmacology approach was then utilized to investigate the probable mechanisms by which WSF improves NAFLD based on the performance of prospective target identification and pathway enrichment analysis. Besides, molecular docking was also conducted for the verification of combination activities between active components of WSF and core proteins related to NAFLD. In final, validation experiments of obtained pathways were conducted through ELISA, immunohistochemistry (IHC), and western blot (WB) analysis. RESULTS: Pharmacodynamic outcomes indicated that WSF intervention effectively mitigated obesity, fat accumulation in organs, lipid metabolism disorders, abnormal transaminase levels and liver pathology injury in NAFLD mice (P < 0.05, 0.01). A total of 72 existent ingredients of WSF were acquired by HPLC-Q-TOF/MS and database, and 254 common targets (11.6% in total targets) of NAFLD and WSF were identified. Network pharmacology revealed that WSF presses NAFLD via modulating TNF, IL6, AKT1, IL1B, PTGS2 (COX2), and other targets, and the probable pathways were primarily inflammatory signaling pathways, as confirmed by molecular docking. Molecular biology experiments further conformed that WSF could decrease levels of inflammatory factors like IL-1beta, IL-6 and TNF-alpha (P < 0.01) and expression of TLR4, NF-kappaB and COX-2 (P < 0.05, 0.01) in the liver. CONCLUSION: WSF treatment effectively protects against lipid metabolism disorders and liver inflammation injury in HSHF diet-induced NAFLD mice, and its molecular mechanism might be via suppressing the TLR4/NF-kappaB/COX-2 inflammatory pathway to reduce the release of inflammatory cytokines in the liver.
abstract_zh: 背景：随着饮食模式的改变，非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）已成为主要的公共健康挑战。遗憾的是，目前仍缺乏针对NAFLD的有效药物治疗方法。王氏经验方（WSF）多年来在治疗代谢性疾病方面显示出显著的临床疗效。然而，WSF对NAFLD的保护作用及其潜在机制仍知之甚少。方法：采用17周高蔗糖高脂（HSHF）饮食建立NAFLD模型，使用32只ICR小鼠。在评估WSF对NAFLD的治疗效果时，我们检测了口服给药后体重、脏器重量、血清和肝脏中糖脂代谢生物标志物、转氨酶水平以及肝脏组织病理学（H&E和Oil Red O染色）的变化。利用HPLC-Q-TOF/MS系统、HMDB、MassBank和TCMSP数据库的数据挖掘，以及CNKI、万方和维普数据库的文献检索，广泛鉴定并收集了WSF中的化学成分。随后，基于前瞻性靶点识别和通路富集分析，利用网络药理学方法的预测来探究WSF改善NAFLD的可能机制。此外，还进行了分子对接以验证WSF活性成分与NAFLD相关核心蛋白之间的结合活性。最后，通过ELISA、免疫组织化学（IHC）和蛋白质印迹（WB）分析对所得通路进行了验证实验。结果：药效学结果表明，WSF干预有效缓解了NAFLD小鼠的肥胖、器官脂肪积累、脂质代谢紊乱、转氨酶水平异常和肝脏病理损伤（P < 0.05, 0.01）。通过HPLC-Q-TOF/MS和数据库共获得WSF的72种现存成分，并鉴定出NAFLD和WSF的254个共同靶点（占总靶点的11.6%）。网络药理学揭示，WSF通过调节TNF、IL6、AKT1、IL1B、PTGS2（COX2）等靶点来抑制NAFLD，可能的通路主要为炎症信号通路，这一点已通过分子对接得到证实。分子生物学实验进一步证实，WSF可降低肝脏中IL-1β、IL-6和TNF-α等炎症因子水平（P < 0.01）以及TLR4、NF-κB和COX-2的表达（P < 0.05, 0.01）。结论：WSF治疗有效保护HSHF饮食诱导的NAFLD小鼠免受脂质代谢紊乱和肝脏炎症损伤，其分子机制可能通过抑制TLR4/NF-κB/COX-2炎症通路来减少肝脏中炎症细胞因子的释放。
